title: Iran Presents US With Roadmap for Regional Ceasefire and Hormuz Reopening in Direct New York Talks
detail: September 23, 2026 — Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met US Special Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, mediated by Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt, for roughly three hours — the first direct high-level US-Iran contact since Trump rejected Pezeshkian's Sep 1 ceasefire overture. Iran presented a roadmap proposing a regional ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, an end to the US economic blockade, a halt to strikes on Iran's Arab neighbors, and a defined negotiation timeline during the truce. Trump said the meeting was 'very good' and that a further round was 'scheduled in the very near future,' with a possible follow-up in Salalah, Oman, but said he would not lift the blockade until Iran shows 'sufficient goodwill,' calling for Iran's 'complete economic isolation' absent an end to its nuclear ambitions and support for proxy groups. The contact follows Iran security chief Mohsen Rezaei's Sep 19 statement that Tehran had already conveyed conditions to Qatari and Pakistani mediators.

title: Board of Peace Unveils $2.45 Billion Six-Month Gaza Recovery Blueprint
detail: September 23, 2026 — Trump's Board of Peace, meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, unveiled a 66-project, $2.45 billion initial-phase recovery plan for Gaza covering roughly six months — about $1 billion for infrastructure (including $400 million for temporary shelters and $275 million for rubble and unexploded-ordnance clearance), plus education, health and economic-recovery spending. The board separately projects $35.2 billion for medium-term reconstruction and $71.4 billion over ten years in total need. High representative Nikolay Mladenov said the board is 'not bound by a calendar' and wants to 'make sure this works.' Nearly a year after the October 2025 ceasefire, implementation remains stalled: Israel controls roughly 60% of Gaza, Hamas has not disarmed, the multinational security force and a new Palestinian governing authority have not deployed, and reconstruction has not begun on the ground — the gap Erdoğan cited in his UN speech a day earlier.

sources.name: KSAT / AP — Trump's Board of Peace proposes $2.45 billion blueprint to begin Gaza reconstruction
